# dan-ui

> Vue 3 UI component library for mid-admin apps, tables, AI chat UI, and rich text.
> npm: @dandan-ui/ui, @dandan-ui/theme
> Docs: https://dandanhub.vip/dan-ui/

## What it is
- Vue 3 component library (Chinese docs first)
- Layout, Form, Table, overlays, AI Chat shells, TipTap RichText
- CSS variables theme (`--dan-*`); dark mode via `html.dark`
- Does NOT embed LLM SDKs or cloud storage SDKs
